name: editor-context-bridge
displayName: Editor Context — share what you're looking at
description: Publishes the file, line range and selected text you are looking at in Cursor/VS Code — over a WebSocket, in process to sibling extensions, and on disk to subscribed agents.

editorContext.enabled.description: Publish the current file and line range. Turning this off removes this window's state file.

editorContext.excludeGlobs.markdownDescription: Files matching any of these globs are never published — the agent is told nothing at all, not even the path. A pattern containing `/` matches the workspace-relative path; a bare pattern matches the file name.

editorContext.language.description: Language of the injected context text.

editorContext.debounceMs.description: Quiet period before a cursor/selection change is written to disk.

editorContext.sendText.markdownDescription: Include the **selected text** in deliveries, not only the address. Applies to deliveries and never to the ambient `windows/<pid>.json`, which stays an address.

editorContext.maxTextBytes.markdownDescription: Byte budget for the selected text; the excess is cut and `textTruncated` is set. `0` disables the cap.

editorContext.ws.enabled.markdownDescription: Run the WebSocket publisher, so a subscriber can connect and receive deliveries without reading the filesystem.

editorContext.ws.host.markdownDescription: Bind address. A **non-loopback** address is refused unless `editorContext.ws.token` is set.

editorContext.ws.port.markdownDescription: Port to listen on; `0` picks a free one, which makes the address change on every restart.

editorContext.ws.token.markdownDescription: Shared secret a subscriber must present in its `subscribe` frame. Required when binding a non-loopback address.
